annotations.title: Fringe Benefit & Welfare Aziendale Tax Optimizer

description:
[Deterministic Italian tax optimization. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates statutory tax exemption limits for employee fringe benefits under Art. 51 TUIR and Legge di Bilancio: 1,000€ standard cap vs 2,000€ cap with dependent children, official ACI fringe benefit tables for company cars in mixed business/personal use based on CO2 emission brackets, electronic meal vouchers (8.00€/day exemption), and domestic utility bill reimbursements.
Usage: Use this tool to structure tax-free corporate welfare and employee benefit packages.
Returns: JSON object with { applicableExemptionCapEur: number, totalFringeBenefitsGrantedEur: number, isWithinTaxFreeCap: boolean, taxableExceedingEur: number, netTaxSavingsEur: number, carFringeBenefitEur: number, mealVouchersTaxFreeEur: number }.

aciMileageRateEur.description: Official ACI tariff per km for 15,000 km standard annual mileage (e.g. 0.45)

employeeAnnualDeductionEur.description: Employee payroll deduction for company car in EUR

nominalVoucherValueEur.description: Nominal face value per voucher (e.g. 8.00 or 10.00 EUR)

companyCar.description: Company car in mixed private/business use specifications
